label: Relight · Qwen Image 2.1
blurb: Changes the lighting of the photo in Image 1: direction, color, time of day. Nothing else moves.
source: ComfyUI template image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit (prompt enhancer left out)
tips: Name the source, direction and color.
Dramatic changes (day to night) work better than subtle ones.

inputs.label: Photo
inputs.hint: Any photo with a person in it.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Relight the photo in <image1>. New lighting: warm golden-hour sun from the left. Light direction, color and shadows change consistently across the face, body and background. Keep the person's identity, expression, pose, clothing, framing and composition exactly as they are.

inputs.label: Step cache
inputs.help: Where Qwen 2.1 keeps its step cache. cpu (RAM) is safe on 16 GB cards and costs little speed. auto and gpu take spare VRAM and can run out of memory.
